title: Energy Vault signs 1.25GW power supply deal with Texas data center developer
summary: Energy Vault has secured a 1.25 GW power supply deal with a Texas data center developer, advancing renewable energy solutions for hyperscaler AI data centers.
body_markdown: Energy storage firm Energy Vault has signed a deal to supply battery energy storage systems (BESS), grid-forming power conversion systems, and AI infrastructure control software for a 1.25GW integrated power deployment at a hyperscale data center development in Texas.
